title: Extraction of a finite trivializing datum
statement: For a field $k$, finite commutative ring $\\Lambda$ and constructible sheaf $G$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], there exists a $LocallyConstantDatum\\ d$ for $G$ such that every member of its finite etale cover restricts $G$ to a constant sheaf with a finite $\\Lambda$-module value.

proof.text: Unpack the constructibility witness S. Its strata cover Spec(k), so choose a stratum j containing the closed point of k. Since Spec(k) is subsingleton, every point belongs to that stratum. The recorded range equality therefore gives range(S.immersion j) = univ.
Apply finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to the finite constant-value datum supplied by constructibility on stratum j. This makes the pullback along S.immersion j finite locally constant.

Apply IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.upperStar_of_range_subset with a = identity of Spec(k) and b = S.immersion j. The latter is an immersion and its range is all of Spec(k). Thus the identity pullback of G is finite locally constant.

Transport finite local constancy through the component at G of Etale.upperStarId. Apply the reverse direction of finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff to G to recover the required datum and its finite constant module values.

proof_origin.place: proof of Lemma 09Z6; S1 Lean proof uses existing immersion-independence and finite constant-value equivalence

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_field_finite_separable_constant_datum
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (G : Sheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hG : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf G) :
    ∃ d : LocallyConstantDatum G, ∀ i : d.cover.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
        Nonempty ((G.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).smallEtaleTopology.over
              (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
